subject: StratusBridge – Joint Field Demo & Cohort Plan
messages:
From: Rachel Summers <rachel@stratusbridge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luis Ortega <luis@stratusbridge.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: StratusBridge x Redwood — regional field demo proposal

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — really excited about a joint effort. StratusBridge runs a small regional field-demo cohort for engineering customers the week of June 14. We think a Redwood co-branded track (45m demo + 15m Q&A) focusing on production inference economics would land well for our customers.

High-level ask: can Redwood provide a speaker (platform + infra), a short co-branded slide deck, and a 10 person early access cohort? We can handle venue logistics and attendee outreach. Attached is a first-pass demo outline (stratus-demo-outline-v2.pdf).

Proposed next steps:
- Can you confirm availability for a pilot session June 16 (AM PST)?
- Who from Redwood should we list as the presenter and co-organizer?
- Any branding or compliance constraints we should know upfront?

CC'ing Luis (our partnerships lead) — he can share the attendee mix.

Thanks,
Rachel Summers
Head of Partnerships, StratusBridge
(rachel@stratusbridge.com)

Attachments: stratus-demo-outline-v2.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Summers <rachel@stratusbridge.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: StratusBridge x Redwood — regional field demo proposal

Rachel — great to hear and thanks for the outline. We're interested and can support the pilot on June 16 (AM PST). Quick notes after reviewing the outline:

- Focus: prefer a hands-on demo of a real inference flow (hosted API -> dedicated fallback) rather than purely slides. Keeps it practical for platform + infra buyers.
- Deck: we'll prepare a co-branded 20-min demo deck + 10-min customer case vignette. I can take the lead on the deck with Ben helping on the demo script.
- Cohort size: 10 is fine; please share the attendee list as a CSV so we can do security/access vetting.
- Legal/compliance: we'll need a standard partner co-marketing addendum (simple one-pager). I can route to legal once we have the attendee list.

Can Jonas drive the logistics for space needs and AV? Ben and I will draft the demo script and a list of infra requirements (GPU, network access, sample dataset).

Next items from us:
- Co-branded deck draft by May 10
- Demo runbook + infra checklist by May 12

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
(irene@redwood.ai)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Summers <rachel@stratusbridge.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Maya Patel <maya@eventspace.co>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: StratusBridge x Redwood — regional field demo proposal

Thanks — looping in Maya from the venue to confirm room layout and AV. A few operational items from my side: 

Logistics checklist (quick):
- Room: classroom + roundtables for 40 (we'll reserve 2 row-front tables for speakers).
- AV: 2x mics (lapel + handheld for Q&A), HDMI + USB-C dongles, confidence monitor for presenter.
- Network: isolated guest Wi-Fi + a private VLAN for demo repro’ing (we'll bring a small edge box).
- Rehearsal: 60 minute run-through the day before (June 15, noon PST).

Staffing (Redwood):
- Primary presenter: Ben Carter (product demos, inference runtime walkthrough)
- Backup: Karthik Iyer (field engineering, hands-on lab support)
- Logistics lead: Jonas Weber (timing, AV, venue ops)

Ben — can you confirm the demo VM + dataset fit in a 20 minute live window and whether we need local GPU access vs. remote API calls? Also attaching a tentative room diagram for Maya to confirm (event-room-layout.png).

Jonas
VP Field Partnerships, Redwood Inference
(jonas@redwood.ai)

Attachments: event-room-layout.png
From: Rachel Summers <rachel@stratusbridge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luis Ortega <luis@stratusbridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: StratusBridge x Redwood — regional field demo proposal

Perfect — thanks for the clear plan. Confirming the following and attaching the attendee CSV (cohort-invite-list.csv):

Confirmed items:
- Pilot session: June 16, 09:30 — 11:00 AM PST (we'll do 45/15 format within that window).
- Speaker slots: Ben Carter (primary), Karthik Iyer (lab support).
- Rehearsal: June 15, 12:00 PM PST.
- Venue ops: Maya will confirm final AV and add a second mic; Jonas to coordinate VLAN access.

Open asks for Redwood before EOD May 10:
- Co-branded deck draft uploaded to the shared Drive link (see below).
- A signed co-marketing addendum (we'll send a short DocuSign once you confirm attendee CSV).

Drive link for materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEfG-stratus-collab

Looking forward to this — I appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Rachel Summers
Head of Partnerships, StratusBridge
(rachel@stratusbridge.com)
